projects.title: Indipick
projects.description: This is an app made as a project for Vilnius University (PSI), it allows users to better plan which studies they want to select and then provide a smooth experience to apply to those subjects.

projects.title: Vector
projects.description: Implementation of a vector data structure in C featuring automatic memory management, element insertion and removal, resizing and vector operations.

projects.title: Queue
projects.description: A queue implementation in C using a circular singly linked list, supporting enqueue and dequeue operations, element lookup and dynamic memory management.

projects.title: Stack
projects.description: An array-based stack implementation in C featuring push, pop, peek and stack state operations with fixed capacity.

projects.title: Graph Traversal
projects.description: A graph traversal implementation in C using the Breadth-First Search (BFS) algorithm. Reads graphs from files and constructs a traversal tree using a queue.

projects.title: Chess game
projects.description: Chess game developed in C++ featuring graphical rendering, piece movement, move validation, turn-based gameplay and check detection.

projects.title: Traffic simulator
projects.description: Traffic intersection simulator developed in Java featuring vehicle movement, right-hand priority rules, collision avoidance and simulation state management.
